data: Exactly six old4A Cal contents; no content replacement; exploratory paired diagnosis, not independent-content validation.

prefixes: A sharp natural-color photograph showing the following scene:
A detailed pencil drawing showing the following scene:
An oil painting showing the following scene:
probe.matching: Exact frozen Stage1 strict graph matcher, original thresholds.
probe.eligibility: At least5/6 strict matches; at least1/2 in each of3 prompts; matched median symmetric distance<=3px; anchor-good-view rate>=5/6.
probe.ranking: Same descending source length / curve index as baseline, then unchanged nine-state input admission. No message/output-coded PNG in selection.

prefixes: A realistic documentary photograph of the following scene:
An expressive watercolor painting of the following scene:
evaluation.isolation: Probe prompts and seeds disjoint from evaluation. Freeze carrier choices/conditions before any evaluation RGB. No holdout reselection.

encoder.rule: Single normal displacement a1*S+a2*T, then one original binary rasterization; never sequential image warps.
encoder.orientation: Original lexicographic canonical endpoints and normalized arc length; fixed tube mask, exterior unchanged.

receivers.SourceRef: Frozen4B R0/A3 candidate pool, joint Huber fit, info gate and old channel/presence; all4 source raster centers, never true-message-guided selection.
receivers.self_reference: Frozen4C0 tube and bbox extraction, fit gates and public Cal models. No retraining or recalibration.
receivers.no_carrier: Four marked attempts remain erasures. Render identity clean conditions for quality bookkeeping, also report quality+correct joint count.

quality.reference: same prompt/seed clean output; diagnostic source comparison also reported
quality.policy: All marked attempts included; zero-change outputs not accepted as transmission

limitations: Six previously developed-on Cal contents, not independent validation.
Clean geometry stability does not guarantee S/T transfer.
Matched-pixel identity after diffusion is not known; no true Oracle claim.
Two-bit all-legal codebook has no authentication redundancy.
Two evaluation views cannot separate prompt effects from seed effects.
